flea.title: Flea File Manager for Omarchy: Install, Keys, Views and FAQ
flea.description: Flea is a fast, keyboard friendly GUI file manager made for Omarchy. Install it with one command, set it as your default, and learn its views, Quick Look and keys.
faqs: What is the flea file manager?
Flea is a GUI file manager made for Omarchy by developer GM (thisisgm on GitHub). It pairs a Rust backend with a Quickshell interface and follows your Omarchy theme.
How do I install flea on Omarchy?
Run omarchy pkg add flea. Add && flea --default to make it your default file manager.
The README says flea is only available from the Omarchy Package Repository now. If you have an older flea-bin or flea-git from the AUR, sudo pacman -S flea replaces it.
How do I make flea my default file manager?
Run flea --default from a terminal in your Omarchy session. It also becomes the app on Super + Shift + F and your Open and Save dialog. flea --default off undoes it.
